rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>We reach Bellforest very soon, but <book(60)>Gekkostate<endbook()> contacted us a moment ago. It seems a <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> unit has found them.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>As soon as we reach Bellforest<thumbnail(175)>, we will support <book(60)>Gekkostate<endbook()>.

<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)><book(60)>Gekkostate<endbook()> was formed by a man named <color(4)>Holland<ce()><thumbnail(176)> who deserted the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> military. It is an anti-<book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> group.
rows.notes: Split into two sentences to keep command order and fit.

rows.en: <operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>They call for protecting the "<book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()>", the land that forms this Earth, and they act to that end.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>Among its members there is also a girl whom <color(4)>Holland<ce()> took out of the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()>, named <color(4)>Eureka<ce()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>She is the rider of a machine called the <book(61)>Nirvash<endbook()><thumbnail(177)>, and also someone needed to protect the <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()>.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>She is not a Newtype. But our ideals and those of <book(60)>Gekkostate<endbook()> resonate in places, and so we help each other.
<operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>The <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> merely wants the power hidden in <color(4)>Eureka<ce()> and the <book(61)>Nirvash<endbook()> as a tool of war.
<thumbdown()><operator(30060,1)><speed(2)>I am sorry to ask this of you, who have no part in it, but I would truly like your cooperation here.
<topic()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)>Now that the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> has marked us, working with these people is the best course. I would like us to help here too.
rows.notes: "karera" = Jamil's side / Gekkostate; "these people" used so it cannot be read as the New Federation.

uncertainties.issue: Bellforest is not in the locked glossary (only in batch_01426 proposals); used that proposal spelling.
"rider" kept from the katakana source word; E7 English materials usually say "pilot". "machine" for kitai (avoids repeating "unit").

"karera to kyouryoku" - referent of "they" inferred as Jamil's group/Gekkostate (not the New Federation); rendered "these people". Last sentence "koko mo kyouryoku shitai" has no subject; "I would like us to help" supplies Ruri as the wisher (omoimasu is first person).

glossary_proposals.why: Eureka Seven town (Renton's home town); not yet in glossary.json.

checked_decisions: Slot 0 title equals missions_019 "05  Support Gekko".

Slot 19 ruling: "Bellforest" is in no locked glossary file; it matches the spelling already used in dialogue batch_01426/review_01426, kept as provisional - orchestrator should add it to glossary.json.
Slot 24 ruling: "rider" kept - the source uses the katakana word itself and it contradicts no glossary entry; "machine" for kitai is correct.

Slot 28 ruling: "karera" = Jamil's side / Gekkostate. The New Federation is the party that marked them, so it cannot be the partner; "these people" is correct. "I would like us to help" - first-person omoimasu, Ruri speaking as captain; accepted.
Slots 20, 21, 24: <thumbnail> sits after the same word as in the source (arrival clause / Holland / Nirvash).
Gekkostate, Scub Coral, Nirvash, Holland, Eureka, New Federation match encyclopedia_022 / glossary spellings. Eureka is called shoujo/kanojo in the source, so "girl"/"she" is sourced.
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 28: "has marked us" supplies the object "us" (source omits it); supported by archive 4003962 slot 26 where Sala says the Nadesico group was marked. Left.
